points.description: Forms A − LC correctly, with LC as the outer product of L = [ℓ1; ℓ2] and C = [1 0], so ℓ1, ℓ2 sit in the first column only: A − LC = [[−ℓ1, 1], [−ℓ2, −2]].
Correct characteristic polynomial det(sI − (A − LC)) = s² + (ℓ1 + 2)s + (2ℓ1 + ℓ2). Equivalent expanded forms accepted.
Correct desired polynomial for a double pole at −10: (s+10)² = s² + 20s + 100.

Matches coefficients to get ℓ1 = 18 and ℓ2 = 64, i.e. L = [18; 64]. Both values must be correct. Follow-through on the student's own polynomial from P2 may earn this mark only if the matching is done correctly.

levels.says: Only one of ℓ1 = 18 or ℓ2 = 64 is correct, or the matching method is right but there is an arithmetic slip.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the correct A − LC, the characteristic polynomial, the desired polynomial s²+20s+100 and L = [18; 64]. Give part marks for correct steps before any error. Do not penalise the same error twice, and accept an equivalent correct method.
